data.heading: Forty-five years of learning that lasts a lifetime
data.description:
Founded in 1981 by a group of teachers and parents, Evergreen Valley Academy has grown from a single classroom into a school and college of over 2,400 students — without losing the warmth of a small community.

We believe in learning by doing: labs, libraries, sports and the arts are part of every student's week, not extras.

data.heading: Built by teachers, shaped by our students
data.description:
What began as a small primary school with 60 children is today a CBSE senior secondary school and an arts & science college affiliated to the state university.

Our mission has never changed: to give every student a rigorous education, a strong sense of values and the confidence to make a difference.

data.heading: Course FAQs
data.description: Can't find an answer? Call the admissions office.

items.question: What is the eligibility for degree programmes?
items.answer: A pass in Class XII (or equivalent) from a recognised board. Some programmes require specific subjects — for example, mathematics for BCA.

items.question: Are scholarships available?
items.answer: Yes. Merit scholarships cover up to 50% of tuition, and need-based support is available. Apply along with the admission form.

items.question: Do you provide hostel accommodation?
items.answer: Yes, separate hostels for boys and girls with supervised study hours and meals.

items.question: Is there an entrance test?
items.answer: School admissions include a simple interaction. Degree admissions are based on Class XII marks and a short interview.

items.question: Which documents are needed?
items.answer: Birth certificate, previous report card, transfer certificate (for Class II and above), Aadhaar and two passport-size photographs.

items.question: Can fees be paid in instalments?
items.answer: Yes, fees can be paid in three term instalments.

items.question: When does the academic year begin?
items.answer: School classes begin in June; degree programmes begin in July.
